unload_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to unload a delayed memory report from the session context.
rules: Emit <UNLOAD_DELAYED_MEMORY: id > to unload one currently loaded LOADED_DELAYED_MEMORY from context in the next turn/message; the saved report is never deleted from storage.
id - is a placeholder word; replace it with the 6-character id prefix shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
